interface.title: DeepMReye – Magnetic resonance-based eye tracking using deep neural networks (Streamlit app)
interface.field: Cognitive neuroscience / fMRI neuroimaging (eye tracking without a camera)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis: getting a derived measure (gaze position) out of already preprocessed fMRI data
interface.what_it_is_for: Estimate where a participant was looking during an fMRI run, using a pretrained deep network applied to the MR signal of the eyeballs in a head-motion-corrected 4D NIfTI file.

data.note: I uploaded test_participant.nii (3.4 MB, from the repo's tests/data) through the file picker. Upload works, and so does choosing a model. Every run then stopped at its first stage, 'download model weights', with a ProxyError: osf.io could not be reached from the sandbox (403 tunnel). This is a limit of the sandbox, not of the tool. Each model asks for a different weights URL: datasets_1to5 → osf.io/download/23t5v, dataset1_guided_fixations → cqf74, dataset3_pursuit → e89wp (the replay also saw 89nky for dataset5_free_viewing). So preprocessing, eyeball extraction, decoding, the result tables and the CSV downloads never appeared. On 127.0.0.1 the page stayed on a loading skeleton; it finished loading only on localhost:8501.

tree.general: Recover a participant's gaze position over time from brain-imaging data recorded without an eye tracker
tree.specific: Decode gaze X/Y per TR from the eyeball MR signal in a 4D fMRI NIfTI with a pretrained DeepMReye model
